scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @news/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.generate:dart-client: pnpm dlx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.json -g dart-dio -o packages/api_client_dart --additional-properties=pubName=news_api_client,pubAuthor=News && dart pub get -C packages/api_client_dart && cd packages/api_client_dart && dart run build_runner build
